audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gives Renekton the First-item and 2+-item rows, but whys[5], whys[6] and spikes[2]/spikes[3] on the same page all describe Galio's tank items blunting your burst and his global R out-valuing your split. The page renders two answers.
audit.why: 50.08% over 2362 games with Galio scaling into tank items; the mirror audit (galio__renekton) already states Galio owns the item rows in prose and only left the enum unflipped because it believed enum edits were length-rejected.
audit.corrected: phases[5].side/win[5] and phases[6].side/win[6] flipped to Galio, proposed as one atomic group with their prose.

audit.whatIsWrong: First-item phase text sold Eclipse as an uncontested spike with no mention that Galio's first tank item lands in the same window.
audit.why: Renekton's power curve is front-loaded; Hollow Radiance/Sunfire absorbs the Eclipse burst the row is built around.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why now keys the fight to your item completing before his.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: empowered W (over 50 Fury) destroys damage shields on the target, and Galio's kit is shields — Shield of Durand (W) and the magic shield from Hero's Entrance (R). The page also never used Justice Punch's real cooldown, and missed that Colossal Smash (P) is an auto-attack reset that telegraphs his step-up.
audit.why: Renekton kit text: empowered W 'destroying damage shields on the target', 1.5s stun vs 0.75s. Galio W and R both carry the shield flag. Justice Punch is 11/10/9/8/7s.
audit.corrected: Shield-destroy and the 1.5s stun stated in tradeGood and dosFull[1].d; Justice Punch's 11s rank-1 cooldown and the Colossal Smash reset tell added to dosFull[0].d and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Punish him when it's down' with no number.
audit.why: Justice Punch is 11s at rank 1, 7s at rank 5 — concrete enough to time a commit.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to dosFull[0].d and report[5].t.
